content:
They wanted the information that you gave them on the fake job application. They may want something more now. If you gave them any passwords, you'll want to change those passwords.

If you want to block messages from these people, see if you can do that through webmail. Thunderbird cannot block messages.

If you want to delete the messages immediately, use shift+delete.

If you want messages to be automatically and permanently deleted when you mark them as junk, I don't know if that is possible. Maybe someone else knows a way.
